core.title: Belmont Single Cylinder Weslock Handleset, Weslock 6691

text.description_html:
Weslock 6691, Single Cylinder Belmont Handleset

The design of this Weslock made handleset features square mounts. The simple yet the classic beauty of the Belmont Single Cylinder Handleset makes it a good choice for those who want to add a touch of quiet embellishment to their doors. It is available in satin nickel and oil rubbed bronze finishes. Easy to install, the Belmont Entryset will fit door thicknesses from 1-3/4 inches to 2 inches. There is an optional thick door kit that will accommodate doors with thicknesses from 2 inches to 2-1/4 inches. It will adjust to fit doors with backsets of 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. A single cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is operated by key from the exterior and a thumbturn from the interior; while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior. An ANSI rated grade 2 lock, this outside trim handleset made by Weslock not only looks fantastic, it is made with the attention to quality Weslock is known for.

Single Cylinder Handleset: From the exterior, a thumb piece operates the latch and a key operates the deadbolt. From the interior, the lever operates the latch and a thumbturn operates the deadbolt.

Also available matching: Belmont Dummy Handleset

This modern styled handleset is from the Weslock Elegance Collection which features lifetime finish and mechanical warranties.

Features of the Single Cylinder Belmont Entry Set:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Meets ANSI A 156.2 grade 2 lock standards.
  • 5-pin cylinder.
  • Adjustable latches with removable faceplates.
  • 1 inch throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers to prevent sawing.
  • Fits standard door preparations with 2-1/8" top (1-5/8" optional) and 2-1/8" bottom cross holes and 1" edge hole and a 5-1/2" center to center cross hole spacing.
  • Manufacturer Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Manufacturer Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Weslock Elegance Collection Woodward II Single Cylinder Handleset:

  • Exterior Length: 19"
  • Exterior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Exterior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Length: 10-1/8"
  • Interior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" to 2" with optional thick door kit for doors 2" to 2-1/4"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplates.

The inside trim will match the handleset's finish.
